The app version could not be saved because Git push exceeded the size limit. First check the project for oversized artifact test outputs, debug files, or attachments. Confirm the cause before removing unnecessary content, and preserve app code and required resources. Large files may already be in unpushed commit history, so deleting them or adding them to .gitignore may not be enough. If history needs to be cleaned up, only modify unpushed commits.
